description.value:
You have honed a talent for impressions and disguise. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks made while impersonating another individual. You can also imitate the voice of a person or the sound made by a creature, provided you have listened to it for at least a minute; a listener can see through the impression only by succeeding on a Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.
